text:
Type: slatted storage chest table
Use: storing blankets or toys, holding drinks in front of a sofa; living room, bedroom, balcony
Style: rustic, bohemian, coastal
Materials: solid acacia in an open lattice of slats, oiled finish
Colors: warm golden brown acacia
Shape: rectangular box shape with a lift-off top, open grid lattice on all sides, plain block base, chunky and solid, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, natural, relaxed, earthy
Goes with: rattan, jute rugs, green plants, white walls; bohemian, coastal or rustic living rooms
